 Appearance :
 For the Appellant/s : Mr.Sunil Kumar Singh
 For the Respondent/s : Mr.Sujit Kumar Singh
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Mohit Kumar Shah
 and
 Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order

(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MOHIT KUMAR SHAH)
3 24-12-2025 We find from the judgment of conviction dated 03.03.2025 that the appellant has been convicted under Sections 363/376/506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 read with Section 3 of the POCSO Act, 2012, hence it is imperative to mask the identity of the respondent no. 2, who is the informant and mother of the victim girl.

2. We also find that though the respondent no. 2 is the mother of the victim, however in the cause title just above her name, victim 'X' has been made party through her mother, which in our view is not required, hence the registry is directed to strike off the inscription made by hand in pen writing.

Thus, we are now left with the mother of the victim girl as the respondent no. 2, hence we direct the registry to mask the name, parentage and other particulars of the respondent no. 2 and instead depict her Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.574 of 2025(3) dt.24-12-2025 as Ms. Y as also mention the name and other particulars of the respondent no. 2 on a sheet of paper, seal the same in an envelop and keep the same on the records of this appeal.

3. We further find that the notices have been validly served upon the respondent no.2, however there is no representation on her behalf, hence it is essential to appoint amicus curiae to assist this Court and provide due opportunity of hearing to the respondent no. 2.

sentences.text:
In such view of the matter, we appoint Ms. Ruchi Mandal, Advocate as amicus curiae to assist this Court on behalf of the respondent no. 2.
5.
Let a copy of this appeal as also the photo copy of the records of the learned trial court be handed over to the learned amicus curiae by 7th January, 2026.

6. List this appeal under the heading 'For Orders' on 21.01.2026.
(Mohit Kumar Shah, J) (Soni Shrivastava, J) devendra/-
